refusal_split.counts: reasons, not references: one reference can fail more than one rule

single_representation_lens.counts: reasons, not references: one reference can carry more than one. These references are excluded from the refusal rate because there was never a comparison to refuse, not because they were approved.

method.population: every reference in the captured RWA map
method.excluded: single-representation references, which cannot be compared at all
method.numerator: references this monitor refuses to compare, by coded rule
